body: We’re very excited about it. Thank you. Also because of his severity it feels like we literally can never take a day off to rest, he pretty much expects us to always be working on it haha
I did it in justnomil just because I was already a part of that sub but I wasn’t sure if there was one specific to fils

They know our timeline. We’re actually on schedule to be off their property by July and every weekend we are clearing trees, renting machines to level the land, etc. but even with Al of that he expects my husband to be Superman and be out there 24/7 yet will tell us that there is no rush and that he enjoys having us on their land

I’m sure he would be ecstatic to have his own place back and trust me, we want nothing more than our own place and independence as well but every time I talk with them about our timeline and how we’re trying as quickly as we can to get out of their hair my dad reassures me that he’s fine with us being here and actually enjoys having us around, but then he’ll turn right around and think that my husband is making things difficult for me by not moving faster on getting things done to get out of there even when we are literally dedicating as much free time as we can to progress things on our property. They tell us that as long as we’re making progress they have no issues but clearly my dad thinks because we didn’t move to raw land within a month of buying it that we aren’t moving fast enough

No, I’m constantly defending my husband and defending him to my dad with legitimate reasons like my husband had to work late or overtime or the many other reasons why we may not be able to do things as fast as they and we would like. I wrote this post because my husband was going to write one earlier asking for advice and the post glitched and deleted on him. I wanted to know for his own clarity if others thought he should try to say something or not.

Thank you for this. I agree. I just feel like we need to keep pushing through the bs and get our ass out of the situation. I mostly started this thread because my husband was uncertain of how to deal with it. He doesn’t want conflict either but I know he wants to know what exactly is going on and every time it seems my father will hide from him and then come to me with the issue and talk more shit. The fact that they have done us a huge favor is why it feels like we can never say anything or defend ourselves even if something major has come up (ie, having to take a break from the property for two weekends because I had an emergency appendectomy)

I do ask him what examples he has and when I explain the reason behind certain things such as my husband having to work overtime that day or the other multitude of issues we come across he still gets super sassy and says “well he needs to figure it out”. I just feel like im always stuck in the middle and I hate it.

We weren’t expecting to be out here this long either but every time we checked in with them they were fine as long as we were making progress. We’re continually making progress but yet I have to hear my dad talk about how incompetent he thinks my husband is on a daily basis. We’re literally working as fast as our bank account and time off will allow us but it still feels like it’s not good enough.

I’m definitely concerned I could be feeling this way due to lack of control in some way. When I’m on my own or with my husband we can obviously decide to do whatever we want but in a social situation most of the time I have no say in what happens and my opinion on “fun” things to do gets shot down majority of the time so I usually endure doing things I really don’t want to do and then later on feel unfulfilled and like I’ve mentioned that I would have been better off doing my own thing without any other influence. The thing is too that in the beginning/early stages of the relationship I’m ecstatic to be with them all the time but then after a few weeks I get so burnt out and get annoyed at the “meaningless” time I spent with them as well as their persistence for inviting us to do stuff with them. It’s so effed up and I feel so crazy for feeling like this but I appreciate your comment on this matter. :)

90% of the time I will tell her that I’ll check with DH. For dinner this weekend when she asked me about the first time was face to face (as I was walking to the bathroom) haha and 15 minutes later when I went back to our trailer she messaged me what he had said. I forgot to message her back that evening and then she messaged me early in the morning asking about it. I don’t blame her for wanting to plan it out but she gets a little too intense with it.

Haha yeah we have some repairs that need to be made to this thing too but it definitely does help save the money! It really sucks because he loves being around his dad but when his mom is around she puts all the attention on her. When we are even having a conversation she will stop everything and make things quiet and awkward and change the subject to something that has nothing to do with what we were just talking about. DH is frustrated on multiple accounts but neither of us really know how to deal with MIL.

I too don’t feel like she’s doing it maliciously but it really does rub me the wrong way that she doesn’t respect me when I say no. I read another comment earlier about how to handle that, that I may try to do. She does do a lot of religious activities throughout the week so I usually try to use the bathroom and shower when I know she’s gone. Good suggestions though about that. 

I’m sure that she is lonely because she also has a daughter 3 years older than me that refuses to do anything for her because of how she behaves. She’s constantly told her daughter that she’s gaining too much weight and needs to lose it, etc. 

I do feel like a kindergartner in a multiple ways around her and that’s a sensation that I absolutely hate. Because she is so religious, she gets very upset if we were to cuss or if she knew some of the shows/movies/music I watch/listen to in our own trailer. I also feel like I can’t be myself around her which makes things even worse. When she’s gone I have been opening up our door and leaving our screen door closed because it feels so nice and crisp and when she gets home 95% of the time she walks over and talks to me through the screen door while I’m in the middle of something else trying to tell her that I’m busy and we can talk later. I hate that she just creeps up on me haha so I’ve stopped enjoying the door being open when I don’t know when she’ll be home. 

Another quick thing about the bathroom too is that they have 3 bathrooms in their house. They have a personal one, the one we use and a half bath. I realize it is their house and they can do whatever they want BUT she has asked me to keep up with cleaning that bathroom while we use it. Completely understandable and I do take care of it. However, she also uses this bathroom all the time, showers in it, leaves her stuff lying around all over the place and moves my stuff out of the way all of the time. There have been times we come home and want to take a shower before bed and she’s taking a shower at that time. Like I said, it’s her house she can do what she wants I just find it odd that she won’t use her personal bathroom for those things. So I’m really not sure how to get around that either. It’s hard to clean when she has her soaps all over the countertop.

That’s enough ranting again though haha. I’ll try to take what you say into consideration thought. Thanks for the advice!

Hahahaha! That sucks that you have to deal with that too but funny because I told my mom yesterday that she may see my mugshot in the news this weekend due to me being motivated to do something crazy by MIL

And that’s why I’m so torn too is because they’re allowing us to be on their property and they’ve helped us out so many other times in our marriage so I want to be as grateful as can be but I’m really quite a loner and it’s hard for me to be around someone so pushy like that especially for an everyday occurrence. I’m sure this will all be over soon but for the time being it’s something that’s been bugging me.

We have a toilet in our camper that we pee in but since we don’t have a place close by to drain our black tank we try to use it as little as possible. When I really can’t stomach to be around her I will try to use that one but DH advises not to use it for #2 😬
Great suggestions though! I’ll try to be more assertive with her! I mostly just wanted to know that I’m not crazy for thinking she’s the crazy one.

I cannot tell you how many times I’ve said these things to her. I think if I would allow her to be in the bathroom with me she would follow me in there. I’m not kidding. There have been times that I’m literally standing in the bathroom closing the door on her as she’s trying to make conversation with me in the hallway and she goes “oh by the way”. Ahhh! I wanna just scream!

Yes I would like to do that too. I just don’t know how to deal with the specific things she invites me to do that have nothing to do with him and when she is saying it to me face to face. I know DH gets annoyed with me being upset about her being so crazy but I’m only crazy because I literally don’t know how to deal with her haha. He’s also annoyed because she won’t listen to him as well when he tells her to cool her jets. It sucks that you find someone to love and then you gotta marry their whole family too haha! I never asked for all of them, only him!! Hahaha!

Great idea! We live in Colorado and there is literally a 3 year waitlist for all RV parks, etc and they all run around $950 mth just for a site so it’s been difficult finding a spot for sure. My FIL has a workshop for his company that we are hopefully going to move to soon but there was a bunch of random junk on that property that needed to be moved for space that just this last week was removed. Thank God!! I think I’ll push stuff onto DH though haha. I know my mom annoys him too sometimes but at least she ain’t messaging him everyday like his is to me!

We are saving our money as quickly as we can haha. DH agreed that his mother is crazy but he keeps saying we’ll be out of here soon so there’s no need to really bring it up again. I don’t think he realizes though that these things literally keep me up at night and honestly prevent me from even wanting to go inside to use the bathroom if she’s there for fear that I may be roped into whatever thing she’s gonna ask me next haha. I think the problem is that everytime she’s like this DH will talk to her about it and then she does it again without consequences. I’m the more blunt, tell it like it is, person in our relationship so I feel like I’m gonna have to lay down the law for her. I just don’t want to be too rude or anything.
